# Hebron Care Adult Family Home LLC #1

> Hebron Care Adult Family Home LLC #1 is a licensed adult family home providing compassionate, personalized senior care in Everett, Washington.

## About

Hebron Care AFH is a residential care home (not a large facility) serving up to 6 residents at a time. We provide 24/7 monitoring, home-cooked meals, and individualized care plans in a family-like environment.

## Location

11320 27th Ave SE, Everett, WA 98208

## Contact

- Phone: (360) 843-7364
- Email: hebroncareafhllc@gmail.com
- Website: https://hebroncareafh.com

## Services

- Personalized daily care plans
- Medication management
- Memory care and cognitive support
- Mobility and daily living assistance
- Home-cooked meals (dietary accommodations available)
- 24/7 staff monitoring
- Gentle morning exercises and activities
- Arts and crafts, music therapy, gardening
- Respite care

## Key Facts

- Licensed by Washington State DSHS
- Staff-to-resident ratio: 1 caregiver to 3-4 residents
- Family visits welcome anytime
- Staff trained in First Aid and CPR
- Accepts Medicaid/DSHS, private pay, and long-term care insurance
